year.$comment: Must match the timeline slider range in index.html (#year-slider min/max).

regionId.$comment: A free-form slug for this event's own bookkeeping. It is NOT checked against any regions.json — this project has no such file. Political-entity linking on the map is done via the 'territory' field below.

territory.$comment: Must exactly match an entity name (a key) in data/historical-enrichment.json's "names" object — which is itself derived from Aourednik's historical-basemaps GeoJSON (SUBJECTO/NAME properties), enriched with Wikidata. scripts/validate_data.py enforces this. A mismatch means the event marker on the map will not be colored the same as the country polygon underneath it.
